commitResults.messageTitle: Add command echoing and bye exit handling
Add in-memory task storage and listing

commitResults.messageBody: Provide a project-local skill and self-contained generator for reviewing Git changes in a split-view HTML page.

Store each task's completion state and support mark <number>.

Update the list output to show done and incomplete task markers.

Encapsulate each task's description and completion state in a dedicated class.

Refactor Bobby to delegate task status changes and display details to Task.
Direct agents to update relevant UI test cases and run the test-ui skill after code changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Todo task empty description error handle
Deadline task missing description error handle
Event task missing description error handle

commitResults.messageBody: Handle invalid commands and incomplete task details through a custom checked exception while preserving the existing user-facing messages.

The task list is not available after restarting Bobby because it is only kept in memory.

Load the task file when Bobby starts, recreate each supported task type, and restore completion status. Add UI coverage for listing tasks restored from disk.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid task inputs and file errors
commitResults.messageBody:
Invalid task numbers, empty input, end-of-file, malformed task data, and failed saves can crash the chatbot or leave its state inconsistent.

Validate command arguments and storage fields, handle end-of-file and malformed files gracefully, and roll back in-memory changes when saving fails. Add UI coverage for the new error paths.
Integrate task persistence and error-handling improvements into the master branch.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support typed deadline dates and times
commitResults.messageBody: Parse ISO dates and day/month/year deadline date-times into LocalDateTime values, format them for display, and persist canonical values. Update the console UI test plan for the new deadline formats.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract console interactions into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move Bobby's banner, command input, separators, task displays, confirmations, errors, and farewell output into a dedicated Ui class. Keep command parsing, task mutations, and persistence in Bobby so this small step preserves the existing console behavior while establishing the first separation of responsibilities.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract task persistence into Storage
commitResults.messageBody: Move the task file path, storage-format parsing, loading, and saving responsibilities out of Bobby and into a dedicated Storage class. Keep the existing file format, error messages, and rollback behavior unchanged while establishing the persistence boundary for the next OOP extraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move command matching, argument extraction, and task-number validation out of Bobby and into a dedicated Parser class. Preserve all existing validation messages and command behavior while establishing the parser boundary for future task-specific command parsing.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: isolate UI cases from persisted data
commitResults.messageBody: Run each UI case in an independent temporary working directory so saved tasks cannot leak between tests. Preserve the intentional save/load handoff for Cases 19 and 20, force UTF-8 Java output on Windows, and correct the Case 24 banner expectation.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract task collection into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Move task storage and collection operations behind a dedicated TaskList abstraction. Update Bobby, Storage, and Ui to use the new API while preserving task ordering, rollback behavior, persistence format, and console output.

Move todo, deadline, and event parsing, validation, and task construction into Parser. Simplify Bobby to dispatch task commands through one shared add/save/rollback path while preserving all existing command behavior and error messages.

Add the abstract Command base and move task insertion, persistence, rollback, and confirmation into AddCommand. Extend Parser with parse() to create executable add commands while preserving the existing console behavior as the first step toward a command hierarchy.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract exit behavior into ExitCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Route explicit bye commands through Parser and ExitCommand, with ExitCommand owning the farewell and exit-state behavior. Keep EOF handling and all existing console output unchanged as the next step toward a complete command hierarchy.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract list behavior into ListCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Route the list command through Parser and ListCommand so task-list display is owned by a dedicated command. Preserve existing list output and keep invalid list arguments handled as unknown commands while continuing the command hierarchy incrementally.

Move mark and unmark task behavior into dedicated commands, including task-index validation, persistence, rollback on save failure, and user feedback. Route both commands through Parser while preserving existing UI output and error handling.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract delete behavior into DeleteCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Move delete task-index validation, removal, persistence, rollback on save failure, and confirmation output into a dedicated command. Route delete through Parser while preserving existing UI behavior and error messages.

Replace Bobby's command-specific branching with a generic Parser.parse and Command.execute flow. Keep empty-input validation, EOF handling, error reporting, and exit detection in the loop while letting each command own its behavior.
Merge the completed OOP stretch-goal work from more-oop into master, including dedicated command classes and centralized command dispatch.
Configure the Gradle application plugin to launch Bobby, matching the current default-package main class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use ASCII banner for portable console output
commitResults.messageBody: Replace Unicode banner characters with ASCII-safe text so Bobby renders consistently across terminals, and update the UI test expectations accordingly. Keep Java source compilation explicitly UTF-8.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: cover Parser command parsing and validation

commitResults.messageBody: Document all public classes and methods, non-trivial private helpers, and supporting state so generated API documentation explains parameters, returns, exceptions, and storage behavior.

Add a project-specific coding-standard skill and mandate it in agent instructions. Move Java sources into the bobby package and update build, documentation, and UI tooling to keep the project and tests working with the standard.

Agent guidance lacks a project-specific standard for Git commits and
branch names, making future changes inconsistent and harder to review.

Add the seedu-git-standard skill and require it in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
Enforce imperative commit subjects, structured WHAT/WHY bodies, and
meaningful kebab-case branch names.
Allow users to find matching tasks with case-insensitive keyword searches, including validation and console feedback. Add unit and UI coverage for matching, empty, and no-result searches.

Integrate task-description search into the bobby package structure and retain its validation, output handling, and test coverage. Resolve the UI package/import conflict so the merged feature builds and behaves consistently with the current branch.
